description: Mathematics for Data Science — Algebra to optimization theory

topics.name: Algebra: Number Systems
topics.prompt: lets talk about number systems, natural integers rational irrational real complex numbers, properties closure commutativity associativity distributivity, and how they form algebraic structures.

topics.name: Optimization: Prime Numbers and Divisibility
topics.prompt: prime numbers, fundamental theorem of arithmetic, GCD LCM Euclidean algorithm, modular arithmetic, Fermat's little theorem, and Euler's totient function.

topics.name: Algebra: Linear Equations and Systems
topics.prompt: linear equations, systems of linear equations, substitution elimination method, Cramer's rule, consistent vs inconsistent systems, and geometric interpretation of solutions.

topics.name: Optimization: Quadratic and Polynomial Equations
topics.prompt: quadratic equations, factoring, completing the square, quadratic formula, discriminant, polynomial equations, Vieta's formulas, and fundamental theorem of algebra.

topics.name: Algebra: Inequalities and Absolute Value
topics.prompt: inequalities, linear inequalities, quadratic inequalities, absolute value equations and inequalities, triangle inequality, AM-GM inequality, and Cauchy-Schwarz inequality.

topics.name: Optimization: Logarithms and Exponents
topics.prompt: logarithms, log properties product quotient power rule, change of base formula, natural log ln, exponential functions, exponential growth decay, and logarithmic scales.

topics.name: Algebra: Sequences and Series
topics.prompt: arithmetic sequences and series, geometric sequences and series, harmonic series, convergence tests for infinite series, telescoping series, and power series.

topics.name: Optimization: Binomial Theorem
topics.prompt: binomial theorem, binomial coefficients, Pascal's triangle, combinatorial interpretation, multinomial theorem, and generating functions.

topics.name: Algebra: Combinatorics
topics.prompt: combinatorics, permutations and combinations, circular permutations, combinations with repetition, inclusion-exclusion principle, pigeonhole principle, and derangements.

topics.name: Optimization: Vectors
topics.prompt: vectors in 2D and 3D, vector operations addition scalar multiplication, dot product, cross product, vector projection, magnitude direction, unit vectors, and geometric interpretations.

topics.name: Algebra: Vector Spaces
topics.prompt: vector spaces, axioms of vector space, subspaces, span of vectors, linear independence, basis, dimension, and examples of vector spaces beyond R^n like function spaces.

topics.name: Optimization: Linear Transformations
topics.prompt: linear transformations, transformation matrix, kernel null space, image range, rank-nullity theorem, composition of transformations, and geometric transformations rotation scaling shear.

topics.name: Algebra: Matrix Operations
topics.prompt: matrix operations, addition, scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication, transpose, trace, block matrices, and computational complexity of matrix multiplication.

topics.name: Optimization: Matrix Types
topics.prompt: special matrix types, identity diagonal symmetric skew-symmetric orthogonal unitary Hermitian, upper lower triangular, sparse matrices, and their properties.

topics.name: Algebra: Determinants
topics.prompt: determinants, cofactor expansion, properties of determinants, row operations effect, determinant and invertibility, determinant of product, and geometric interpretation as volume.

topics.name: Optimization: Matrix Inverse
topics.prompt: matrix inverse, conditions for invertibility, computing inverse via row reduction, adjugate method, properties of inverse, and computational complexity.

topics.name: Algebra: Rank and Null Space
topics.prompt: matrix rank, column space, row space, null space, rank-nullity theorem, computing rank via row echelon form, and applications in solving linear systems.

topics.name: Optimization: Gaussian Elimination
topics.prompt: Gaussian elimination, row echelon form, reduced row echelon form, pivot columns, free variables, LU decomposition, and computational complexity.

topics.name: Algebra: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
topics.prompt: eigenvalues and eigenvectors, characteristic polynomial, computing eigenvalues, eigenspaces, algebraic vs geometric multiplicity, and eigendecomposition.

topics.name: Optimization: Diagonalization
topics.prompt: matrix diagonalization, conditions for diagonalizability, spectral theorem for symmetric matrices, matrix powers via diagonalization, and applications in dynamical systems.

topics.name: Algebra: SVD
topics.prompt: singular value decomposition SVD, computing SVD, relationship with eigendecomposition, geometric interpretation, truncated SVD, pseudo-inverse Moore-Penrose, and applications in data science PCA.

topics.name: Optimization: Matrix Norms
topics.prompt: matrix norms, Frobenius norm, spectral norm operator norm, nuclear norm trace norm, vector norms L1 L2 Linf, and how norms are used in regularization.

topics.name: Algebra: Positive Definite Matrices
topics.prompt: positive definite matrices, positive semi-definite, tests for positive definiteness eigenvalues leading minors Cholesky, Cholesky decomposition, and role in optimization.

topics.name: Optimization: QR Decomposition
topics.prompt: QR decomposition, Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization process, Householder reflections, Givens rotations, applications in least squares, and QR algorithm for eigenvalues.

topics.name: Algebra: Least Squares
topics.prompt: least squares problem, normal equations, geometric interpretation projection, weighted least squares, ridge regression as regularized least squares, and iterative methods.

topics.name: Optimization: Tensor Operations
topics.prompt: tensors, tensor order and shape, tensor contraction, Einstein summation convention einsum, outer product, Kronecker product, and tensor decompositions CP Tucker.

topics.name: Algebra: Limits
topics.prompt: limits, epsilon-delta definition, limit laws, one-sided limits, limits at infinity, infinite limits, squeeze theorem, and L'Hopital's rule.

topics.name: Optimization: Continuity
topics.prompt: continuity, definition at a point and on interval, types of discontinuity removable jump essential, intermediate value theorem, extreme value theorem, and uniform continuity.

topics.name: Algebra: Derivatives
topics.prompt: derivatives, power rule, product rule, quotient rule, chain rule, implicit differentiation, logarithmic differentiation, higher-order derivatives, and derivative as rate of change.

topics.name: Optimization: Applications of Derivatives
topics.prompt: applications of derivatives, finding maxima minima, first and second derivative tests, optimization problems, related rates, curve sketching, mean value theorem, Rolle's theorem.

topics.name: Algebra: Taylor and Maclaurin Series
topics.prompt: Taylor series, Maclaurin series, Taylor polynomial approximation, remainder term, convergence radius, common Taylor expansions e^x sin cos ln, and applications in numerical methods.

topics.name: Optimization: Integration Techniques
topics.prompt: integration, Riemann sums, fundamental theorem of calculus, substitution method, integration by parts, partial fractions, trigonometric substitution, and numerical integration.

topics.name: Algebra: Improper Integrals
topics.prompt: improper integrals, infinite limits of integration, unbounded integrands, convergence tests comparison test limit comparison, and Gamma function Beta function.

topics.name: Optimization: Applications of Integration
topics.prompt: applications of integration, area between curves, volume of revolution disk washer shell methods, arc length, surface area, and probability density functions.

topics.name: Algebra: Partial Derivatives
topics.prompt: partial derivatives, geometric interpretation, notation, higher-order partial derivatives, Clairaut's theorem mixed partials equality, and partial derivatives in machine learning.

topics.name: Optimization: Gradient and Directional Derivative
topics.prompt: gradient vector, directional derivative, gradient as direction of steepest ascent, gradient descent intuition, level curves and gradient perpendicularity, and nabla operator.

topics.name: Algebra: Jacobian and Hessian
topics.prompt: Jacobian matrix for vector-valued functions, Hessian matrix of second partial derivatives, Hessian in optimization second-order conditions, and Newton's method using Hessian.

topics.name: Optimization: Multivariable Chain Rule
topics.prompt: multivariable chain rule, total derivative, implicit function theorem, backpropagation as chain rule application, and computational graph for automatic differentiation.

topics.name: Algebra: Lagrange Multipliers
topics.prompt: constrained optimization, Lagrange multipliers method, equality constraints, geometric interpretation, multiple constraints, and connection to KKT conditions.

topics.name: Optimization: Multiple Integrals
topics.prompt: double integrals, triple integrals, iterated integrals, Fubini's theorem, change of variables polar cylindrical spherical coordinates, and Jacobian determinant for substitution.

topics.name: Algebra: Vector Calculus
topics.prompt: vector calculus, line integrals, surface integrals, Green's theorem, Stokes' theorem, divergence theorem, curl divergence gradient of vector fields, and conservative fields.

topics.name: Optimization: First-Order ODEs
topics.prompt: ordinary differential equations, first-order ODEs, separable equations, exact equations, integrating factors, linear first-order ODEs, Bernoulli equations, and existence uniqueness theorem.

topics.name: Algebra: Second-Order Linear ODEs
topics.prompt: second-order linear ODEs, homogeneous with constant coefficients, characteristic equation, undetermined coefficients, variation of parameters, and applications spring-mass systems.

topics.name: Optimization: Laplace Transforms
topics.prompt: Laplace transforms, definition and properties, inverse Laplace transform, solving ODEs with Laplace transforms, transfer functions, and convolution theorem.

topics.name: Algebra: Sample Space and Events
topics.prompt: probability fundamentals, sample space, events, axioms of probability Kolmogorov, addition rule, complement rule, and counting methods for probability.

topics.name: Optimization: Conditional Probability and Bayes
topics.prompt: conditional probability, multiplication rule, law of total probability, Bayes' theorem derivation and intuition, prior posterior likelihood, and Bayesian reasoning examples.

topics.name: Algebra: Random Variables
topics.prompt: random variables, discrete vs continuous, PMF probability mass function, PDF probability density function, CDF cumulative distribution function, and expected value variance.

topics.name: Optimization: Expectation and Variance
topics.prompt: expectation properties linearity, variance and standard deviation, covariance, correlation coefficient, independence, and moment generating functions.

topics.name: Algebra: Common Discrete Distributions
topics.prompt: discrete distributions, Bernoulli, binomial, Poisson, geometric, negative binomial, hypergeometric, and their PMFs means variances and applications.

topics.name: Optimization: Common Continuous Distributions
topics.prompt: continuous distributions, uniform, normal Gaussian, exponential, gamma, beta, chi-squared, Student's t, F-distribution, Weibull, log-normal, and their PDFs means variances.

topics.name: Algebra: Joint Distributions
topics.prompt: joint distributions, joint PMF PDF, marginal distributions, conditional distributions, independence of random variables, joint CDF, and transformation of random variables.

topics.name: Optimization: Multivariate Normal
topics.prompt: multivariate normal distribution, mean vector, covariance matrix, marginal and conditional distributions, Mahalanobis distance, and applications in ML.

topics.name: Algebra: Law of Large Numbers
topics.prompt: law of large numbers weak and strong versions, convergence in probability vs almost sure convergence, Monte Carlo estimation, and practical implications for sampling.

topics.name: Optimization: Central Limit Theorem
topics.prompt: central limit theorem statement and proof sketch, convergence to normal distribution, sampling distribution of mean, confidence interval derivation, and CLT applications.

topics.name: Algebra: Concentration Inequalities
topics.prompt: concentration inequalities, Markov's inequality, Chebyshev's inequality, Chernoff bounds, Hoeffding's inequality, and applications in learning theory PAC bounds.

topics.name: Optimization: Maximum Likelihood Estimation
topics.prompt: MLE maximum likelihood estimation, likelihood function, log-likelihood, MLE for normal distribution, MLE for Bernoulli, consistency asymptotic normality, and Fisher information.

topics.name: Algebra: MAP and Bayesian Estimation
topics.prompt: MAP maximum a posteriori estimation, relationship with MLE, prior as regularization, Bayesian estimation posterior mean, and comparison MLE vs MAP vs Bayesian.

topics.name: Optimization: Confidence Intervals
topics.prompt: confidence intervals, z-interval, t-interval, interpretation of confidence level, confidence interval for proportion, sample size determination, and bootstrap confidence intervals.

topics.name: Algebra: Bayesian Inference
topics.prompt: Bayesian inference, prior distributions informative non-informative Jeffrey's, conjugate priors, posterior computation, Bayesian updating, and credible intervals vs confidence intervals.

topics.name: Optimization: MCMC Methods
topics.prompt: MCMC Markov chain Monte Carlo, Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, Gibbs sampling, convergence diagnostics, burn-in, thinning, and applications in Bayesian posterior sampling.

topics.name: Algebra: EM Algorithm
topics.prompt: EM expectation-maximization algorithm, E-step and M-step, convergence to local maximum, applications GMM parameter estimation, missing data, and variational EM.

topics.name: Optimization: Entropy and Information Theory
topics.prompt: Shannon entropy, cross-entropy, KL divergence asymmetry, mutual information, joint entropy, conditional entropy, data processing inequality, and connections to ML loss functions.

topics.name: Algebra: Convex Sets and Functions
topics.prompt: convex sets, convex functions, concave functions, Jensen's inequality, epigraph, sublevel sets, operations preserving convexity, and identifying convex optimization problems.

topics.name: Optimization: Gradient Descent Convergence
topics.prompt: gradient descent algorithm, convergence analysis, step size selection, Lipschitz continuity, strong convexity, convergence rates O(1/t) vs O(e^-t), and gradient descent variants.

topics.name: Algebra: KKT Conditions and Duality
topics.prompt: KKT Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions, Lagrangian function with inequality constraints, primal and dual problems, strong duality Slater's condition, and complementary slackness.

topics.name: Optimization: Linear Programming
topics.prompt: linear programming, standard form, simplex method, interior point methods, LP duality, sensitivity analysis, and applications in resource allocation.

topics.name: Algebra: Newton and Quasi-Newton Methods
topics.prompt: Newton's method for optimization, quadratic convergence, Hessian computation cost, quasi-Newton methods BFGS L-BFGS, secant condition, and line search methods.

topics.name: Optimization: Proximal and ADMM Methods
topics.prompt: proximal gradient methods, proximal operator, ISTA FISTA for L1 regularization, ADMM alternating direction method of multipliers, and applications in distributed optimization.

topics.name: Algebra: Graph Theory Fundamentals
topics.prompt: graph theory, graphs directed undirected weighted, adjacency matrix adjacency list, degree, paths cycles, connectivity, BFS DFS traversals, and graph properties.

topics.name: Optimization: Graph Algorithms
topics.prompt: graph algorithms, shortest paths Dijkstra Bellman-Ford, minimum spanning tree Kruskal Prim, topological sort, graph coloring, bipartite matching, and network flow max-flow min-cut.

topics.name: Numerical Optimization: Quasi-Newton Methods (BFGS Update Step)
topics.prompt: explain Quasi-Newton BFGS optimization, the secant equation, and formulating rank-2 updates to approximate the inverse Hessian matrix

topics.name: Numerical Optimization: Memory-Reduced L-BFGS Two-Loop Recursion
topics.prompt: explain Limited-memory BFGS (L-BFGS), state saving using vector history, and the two-loop recursion algorithm to compute search directions

topics.name: Numerical Optimization: Newton-Raphson Step Size and Convergence Rates
topics.prompt: explain multi-dimensional Newton's optimization step delta x = - H^(-1) * g, and quadratic convergence guarantees

topics.name: Constrained Optimization: Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) Conditions
topics.prompt: explain Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) stationarity, primal feasibility, dual feasibility, and complementary slackness conditions for inequality constraints

topics.name: Constrained Optimization: Lagrange Multipliers and Support Vector Boundaries
topics.prompt: explain method of Lagrange multipliers, formulating dual optimization problems, and finding optimal hyperplanes in support vector machines

topics.name: Linear Algebra: Singular Value Decomposition Low-Rank Matrix Approximation
topics.prompt: explain Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) matrix factorization A = U * Sigma * V^T, and Eckart-Young-Mirsky low-rank matrix approximation

topics.name: Linear Algebra: Eigenvalue and Eigenvector Diagonalization
topics.prompt: explain eigenvector diagonalization A = P * D * P^(-1), characteristic polynomial calculations, and geometric vs algebraic multiplicity

topics.name: Probability: Bayes Theorem and Gaussian Mixture Models
topics.prompt: explain Bayes theorem, prior/likelihood/posterior probability formulations, and parameter fitting in Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)

topics.name: Probability: Markov Chains Transition Probabilities and Steady State
topics.prompt: explain discrete-time Markov chains, transition probability matrices, stationary distribution vectors, and absorbing states

topics.name: Newton-CG Method for Large-Scale Non-Convex Problems
topics.prompt: Derive the exact CG (Conjugate Gradient) iteration for the Newton system in a non-convex loss landscape with L-BFGS preconditioning. Implement this in PyTorch for a ResNet-50 on ImageNet with a batch size of 256, and analyze the trade-off between Hessian-vector product calls and convergence speed. Include a comparison with AdamW using the same hyperparameters.

topics.name: Gauss-Newton Approximation in Neural Network Training
topics.prompt: Implement the exact Gauss-Newton matrix-vector product for a 3-layer MLP on the MNIST dataset, but replace the true Hessian with the Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) block-diagonal approximation. Compare the training dynamics (loss curve, gradient variance) against SGD+momentum and Adam. Rigorously justify why K-FAC’s approximations matter for second-order optimization.

topics.name: Trust-Region Methods with Eigenvalue-Based Radius Adaptation
topics.prompt: Design a trust-region algorithm where the radius is dynamically adjusted based on the smallest eigenvalue of the Hessian approximation (computed via power iteration). Implement this for a logistic regression problem on the covtype dataset (581K samples) with a dense Hessian. Compare against Levenberg-Marquardt and analyze how eigenvalue sensitivity affects convergence.

topics.name: Second-Order Meta-Learning for Few-Shot Optimization
topics.prompt: Implement a MAML-like algorithm where the meta-update step uses a full Newton step on the inner-loop Hessian (computed via Hutchinson’s trace estimator). Train a 4-layer CNN on the miniImageNet dataset with 5-way 1-shot tasks. Compare the convergence speed and generalization gap against first-order meta-learning baselines (e.g., Reptile) and analyze the effect of Hessian conditioning.

topics.name: Stochastic Quasi-Newton Methods with Coupled Sampling
topics.prompt: Develop a stochastic L-BFGS variant where the Hessian approximation updates are coupled with a stratified sampling strategy that prioritizes samples with high gradient variance. Implement this for a Transformer (6-layer, 8 heads) on the WMT’14 dataset. Compare against Adam and SGD with momentum, and provide a theoretical justification for the coupling mechanism.

topics.name: Newton-CG Method: Solving Large-Scale Nonlinear Optimization with Linear Conjugate Gradient Subproblems
topics.prompt: Let's implement the Newton-CG method from scratch to solve a non-convex deep learning loss landscape (e.g., training a ResNet-50 on CIFAR-10) and analyze how the Hessian-vector product approximation via CG affects convergence speed and memory efficiency compared to BFGS.

topics.name: Gauss-Newton Matrix-Free Optimization for Neural Network Training: Levenberg-Marquardt Adaptations
topics.prompt: Implement a matrix-free Gauss-Newton optimizer for training a Transformer model on a machine translation task, and compare its performance to AdamW in terms of generalization error and convergence speed. Use the Fisher Information Matrix approximation via Hutchinson’s trace estimator.

topics.name: Quasi-Newton Methods with Limited-Memory BFGS (L-BFGS) for High-Dimensional Parameter Spaces
topics.prompt: Design an L-BFGS optimizer for fine-tuning a large language model (e.g., BERT-base) on a domain-specific dataset. Experiment with different history lengths (e.g., 10 vs. 20) and analyze how the trade-off between memory usage and convergence rate impacts downstream task performance.

topics.name: Second-Order Stochastic Optimization via Stochastic Newton and SARAH: Theory and Implementation
topics.prompt: Derive and implement the Stochastic Newton method and SARAH algorithm for training a CNN on MNIST in a distributed setting. Compare their empirical convergence rates and generalization performance against SGD and Adam, and explain why second-order methods may or may not outperform first-order methods in stochastic regimes.

topics.name: Hessian-Free Optimization for Reinforcement Learning: Trust-Region Policy Optimization (TRPO) and CMA-ES
topics.prompt: Implement the Hessian-free optimization component of TRPO to train a policy for the MuJoCo Ant-v4 environment. Compare its performance to standard policy gradient methods (e.g., PPO) and analyze how the conjugate gradient solver’s accuracy in approximating the natural gradient impacts learning stability.

topics.name: Newton-CG Conjugate Gradient for Non-Convex Problems: Implementing Hessian-Free Optimization for Deep Learning
topics.prompt: Let's implement a Hessian-Free Optimization (HFO) variant using the Newton-CG algorithm to train a deep neural network on a non-convex objective like CIFAR-10 with a custom loss function. We need to solve the linear system ∇²f(x) * p = -∇f(x) using Conjugate Gradient (CG) at each step, while handling indefinite Hessians via Levenberg-Marquardt damping. Can we derive the exact stopping criteria for CG to ensure superlinear convergence? Show me the full PyTorch implementation with hooks for Hessian-vector products.

topics.name: BFGS with Exact Line Search vs. Wolfe Conditions: Benchmarking Quasi-Newton Methods on L-BFGS-B for Large-Scale SVM Training
topics.prompt: Compare the performance of L-BFGS-B using exact line search (Armijo + Wolfe conditions) versus inexact line search (backtracking only) when training a linear SVM on the MNIST dataset with 1M samples. We need to derive the Wolfe conditions for the BFGS update and implement both variants from scratch in Python. How does the curvature condition (yᵀs > 0) affect the Hessian approximation accuracy? Plot the convergence curves for both methods and analyze the trade-off between computational overhead and convergence speed.

topics.name: Second-Order Optimization in Reinforcement Learning: Trust-Region Policy Optimization (TRPO) with Exact Fisher Information Matrix
topics.prompt: Implement Trust-Region Policy Optimization (TRPO) for a continuous control task (e.g., HalfCheetah) using the exact Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) instead of the diagonal or Kronecker-factored approximations. Derive the KL divergence constraint and the conjugate gradient solver for the natural gradient step. How does the choice of FIM approximation (e.g., full vs. block-diagonal) impact policy update stability? Provide a full TensorFlow implementation with debug prints for the FIM eigenvalues.

topics.name: Curvature-Aware Adaptive Learning Rates: Deriving the Newton-Momentum Hybrid for Transformer Training
topics.prompt: Design a second-order optimization variant that combines Newton’s method with momentum for training a Transformer on the WikiText-103 dataset. Use a diagonal Hessian approximation (e.g., via Hutchinson’s method) to compute per-parameter learning rates, then apply Nesterov momentum with a curvature-aware restarts. Derive the update rule and implement it in PyTorch. How does this hybrid method compare to AdamW in terms of perplexity convergence and memory usage? Provide a full training loop with logging.

topics.name: Stochastic Second-Order Methods for Distributed Optimization: Implementing Distributed L-BFGS with Compression and Gradient Coding
topics.prompt: Implement a distributed L-BFGS algorithm for training a ResNet-50 on ImageNet across 8 GPUs, where each worker computes a stochastic Hessian-vector product using mini-batches. Introduce gradient coding to handle stragglers and a novel compression scheme for Hessian approximations (e.g., 4-bit quantization of curvature pairs). Derive the convergence guarantees for this compressed second-order method. How does the compression ratio affect the final test accuracy compared to synchronous SGD? Provide the full PyTorch DistributedDataParallel implementation with a custom AllReduce hook.

topics.name: Newton-CG: Implementing Conjugate Gradient Preconditioning for Large-Scale Quadratic Problems
topics.prompt: How would you modify the Newton-CG algorithm to handle a 100k-dimensional Hessian in a logistic regression setting where the Hessian is only available as a matrix-free operator? Provide the pseudo-code for the inner CG loop with a block-Jacobi preconditioner, and discuss how you'd ensure numerical stability when the condition number exceeds 1e6.

topics.name: BFGS with Limited-Memory Symmetric Rank-1 Updates for Non-Convex Deep Learning
topics.prompt: Derive the BFGS update rule when the inverse Hessian approximation is stored using a compact representation with 5 memory pairs. Implement this in PyTorch for a non-convex loss landscape (e.g., ResNet-50 on ImageNet). Explain how you'd handle cases where the curvature condition fails, and why the SR1 variant might outperform BFGS in high-noise regimes.

topics.name: Gauss-Newton with Automatic Differentiation for Tensor Network Approximations
topics.prompt: Formulate the Gauss-Newton approximation for optimizing a Tensor Network (e.g., MPS or PEPS) subject to a non-linear loss. Provide the AD-based workflow to compute the Jacobian blocks without explicitly forming the full tensor. Discuss how you'd exploit the Kronecker product structure in the GN matrix for efficient inversion using the Levenberg-Marquardt damping strategy.

topics.name: Trust-Region Methods with Exact Second-Order Models for Non-Smooth Constrained Optimization
topics.prompt: Implement a trust-region algorithm for solving a constrained problem where the objective is the sum of a smooth quadratic and an L1-regularizer (e.g., sparse portfolio optimization). How would you handle the non-smoothness in the subproblem? Derive the Cauchy point and dogleg step with exact second-order models, and discuss the convergence guarantees when the trust-region radius is updated using a ratio of actual to predicted reduction.

topics.name: Second-Order Optimization for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with Adaptive Metrics
topics.prompt: Design a second-order optimizer for Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) where the metric tensor is learned via a Riemannian metric (e.g., Fisher information matrix). Provide the mathematical formulation for the Riemannian Newton step, and discuss how you'd stabilize the inverse metric computation in high-dimensional spaces (e.g., VAEs with 1M parameters). Implement a mini-batch version of the optimizer and analyze its bias-variance tradeoff.

topics.name: Hessian-Free Optimization for Training Deep Neural Networks
topics.prompt: Let's implement and analyze the Hessian-free optimization (HFO) method to train a deep neural network on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Start by deriving the Newton step approximation using the conjugate gradient method for solving the linear system involving the Hessian-regularized matrix. Then, compare its convergence rate and computational overhead against SGD and Adam for a ResNet-50 architecture. Include the effect of damping parameter tuning on the loss landscape.

topics.name: Quasi-Newton Methods with Limited-Memory BFGS (L-BFGS) in Distributed Systems
topics.prompt: Design a distributed L-BFGS implementation for optimizing a logistic regression model across 8 GPU nodes. Begin by deriving the two-loop recursion for the approximate Hessian inverse and adapt it for asynchronous updates with staleness tolerance. Measure the impact of varying memory size (m) on the convergence speed and communication overhead. Use PyTorch Distributed and compare against distributed SGD with momentum.

topics.name: Newton-CG for Non-Convex Optimization in Reinforcement Learning
topics.prompt: Implement a Newton-CG optimizer for policy gradient methods in reinforcement learning (e.g., PPO) applied to the MuJoCo Hopper-v4 environment. Formulate the Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) as the Hessian approximation and derive the CG solver for the Newton direction. Evaluate the policy updates' stability and sample efficiency against first-order methods like TRPO and PPO with Adam. Discuss the challenges of Hessian-vector products in high-dimensional action spaces.

topics.name: Second-Order Optimization in Hyperparameter Optimization via Bayesian Neural Networks
topics.prompt: Develop a second-order hyperparameter optimizer using Laplace approximation for a Bayesian Neural Network (BNN) on the MNIST dataset. Derive the Hessian of the log-posterior for the BNN weights and use it to approximate the posterior predictive distribution. Compare the proposed method against first-order hyperparameter optimizers (e.g., Hyperband) in terms of convergence speed and robustness to noisy evaluations. Include code for automatic relevance determination (ARD) kernels.

topics.name: Curvature-Aware Optimization for Transformer Fine-Tuning
topics.prompt: Investigate the effect of second-order optimization (e.g., K-FAC or AdaHessian) on fine-tuning a pre-trained BERT model on the GLUE benchmark. Derive the Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) update rule and implement it in PyTorch. Compare its performance in terms of convergence speed, final accuracy, and memory usage against Adam and SGD with warm restarts. Analyze the curvature statistics of the loss landscape for different layers.
